rationale.A: Kaisaniemi park, but rides Pitkäsilta in traffic with tram rails; 5 lights
rationale.B: Kaisaniemi park then Eläintarhantie side path, no mixed traffic, 2 lights; +1 min
rationale.D: Same line as A but on the Pitkäsilta/Unioninkatu side tracks; 5 lights
rationale.E: Töölönlahti park; Eläintarhantie side path; 2 lights, +3 min
rationale.F: Kaisaniemi then Hakaniemenranta side paths; 2 lights, +3 min
rationale.H: Through the station area beside Kaivokatu/Unioninkatu, 8 lights

notes: B saves 3 lights and drops A's tram-rail stretch on Pitkäsilta for +1 min, so one route covers both cards. A and D take the same line; D uses the side track where A rides the carriageway on Pitkäsilta.
